formation-pathway.alt: Enthalpy ladder for CH₄ + 2 O₂ → CO₂ + 2 H₂O(l). A dashed reference line marks the elements in their standard states (ΔH°f = 0). The reactants lie 74.8 kJ below it and the products 965.1 kJ below it. Step 1 takes the reactants apart into elements (+74.8 kJ); step 2 builds the products from elements (−965.1 kJ); overall ΔH° = −890.3 kJ.
